question: What ritual act binds the eastern direction using the discus and its mantra?
premises: The eastern direction is the object to be bound.
The discus serves as the instrument.
The mantra includes obeisance to the consort of the discus-fire.
inference: The practitioner secures the eastern direction by ritually binding it with the discus and its associated mantra.
plain_english: One binds the eastern direction with the discus, saying: obeisance to the consort of the discus-fire.
